mapper.insert: insert into account (account_id, account_pw, account_nickname, account_email, account_birth, account_contact, account_post, account_address1, account_address2) values ( #{accountId}, #{accountPw}, #{accountNickname}, #{accountEmail}, #{accountBirth}, #{accountContact}, #{accountPost}, #{accountAddress1}, #{accountAddress2} )
mapper.select: select * from account where instr(${column}, #{keyword}) > 0 and account_level != '관리자' order by ${column} asc, account_id asc
